code-based Chladni eigenmodes: (4,2), (2,4), (3,3), (5,1). the nodal lines are where cos(nπx)cos(mπy) - cos(mπx)cos(nπy) = 0.

not boundaries — the shape of what the equation annihilates. positive and negative regions hold the standing wave; the white lines hold nothing and carry the structure.

images.alt: Four Chladni eigenmode patterns on square plates in a 2x2 grid. Deep navy background with blue-positive and red-negative vibration zones separated by thin white nodal lines. Mode labels: (4,2), (2,4), (3,3), (5,1)
